calculate_potential.name: Calculate the potential
calculate_potential.description: Replays the history of each vehicle with other ways of charging (as it was, spread over the parking time, the wallbox's own ready-by with a low current, the peak guard) and compares the monthly peak, the demand charge and how often the car would not have been ready. Read only, an estimate. Administrators only.

days.name: Days
days.description: How far back (14 to 365 days, default 90).

create_dashboard.name: Create the dashboard
create_dashboard.description: Builds the Plugwhen dashboard with the entities of this installation (all vehicles) and returns it as YAML, also as a notification, to paste into a new dashboard (Edit, Raw configuration editor). Only standard cards. It never changes an existing dashboard. Administrators only.

user.title: Plugwhen
user.description: Works out when to plug in so that the car is ready when you leave. Vehicles are added afterwards on the integration page.

init.title: Connections
init.description: Optional. Plugwhen also works alone. Connect it to what you have: the load forecast of the quarter-hour peak guard (keeps the car's charging under the peak target) and a sensor of the availability interface (when power is cheap or free).

data.use_solar_forecast: Use the solar forecast of the Energy dashboard
data.price_low: Demand charge per kW and year

data_description.waechter_entry: Choose the quarter-hour peak guard and Plugwhen finds its load forecast by itself (and keeps the charging under its peak target). Suggested automatically if exactly one is installed.
data_description.load_entity: Only for another source: a sensor with the attributes hours (t, typical, high) and target_kw. Not needed when you chose the peak guard.
data_description.availability_entity: A sensor with the attributes schema (1), valid_until and forecast (a list of start, end, kw), for example from an energy community or a solar forecast.
data_description.use_solar_forecast: Charge from the expected solar surplus first while the car is at home, then spread the rest over the parking time. Works with any solar forecast set up in the Energy dashboard; without one the rest is simply spread.
data_description.solar_deduct_kw: kW taken off the solar forecast first, for what the house and a home battery use. Empty: learned from the night-time base load of the grid import counter (default 0.5 kW until then).
data_description.grid_energy_entity: For the potential calculator: the meter's import counter (Wh or kWh, with long-term statistics). Taken from the quarter-hour peak guard if it is chosen.
data_description.price_low: For the potential calculator, in your currency per kW and year (up to the threshold). Empty: taken from the peak guard, otherwise only kW are shown.
data_description.price_high: Price per kW and year above the threshold. Empty: the same price.
data_description.price_threshold: kW from which the higher price applies. 0 = one price.

user.title: Vehicle
user.description: Plugwhen learns from the history of this car how far it drives, when it leaves and where it is charged.

data.name: Name
data.soc_max_age_h: Maximum age of the state of charge

data_description.odometer_entity: Sensor with the odometer (km or miles). It needs long-term statistics (a state class), that is where Plugwhen learns from.
data_description.soc_entity: Sensor with the state of charge of the battery in percent.
data_description.soc_max_age_h: If the state of charge was not written for longer than this, Plugwhen treats it as unknown: no plan, no warning. A parked car that sleeps is fine up to this age. While the car is charging, 90 minutes without a new value already count as stale (many cars send nothing while charging). 0 = no limit.
data_description.reserve_km: The car should leave with at least this range. You can change it later with the Reserve entity.
data_description.consumption_kwh_100: Used until the car's own consumption is known (typical: 15 to 25 kWh per 100 km).
data_description.charge_kw_max: What the wallbox can deliver at most. The plan never plans more.
data_description.charge_kw_min: Lowest charging power of the wallbox (1 phase, 6 A is about 1.4 kW).
data_description.charge_kw_pref: The plan spreads the charging no flatter than this (the car's charger wastes more energy at very low power); only if the energy does not fit that way it goes down to the minimum. Default 4 kW.
data_description.plugged_entity: On when the car is plugged in. Needed for the warning "plug in".
data_description.charging_entity: On while the car is charging. No warning is sent while it charges.
data_description.wallbox_energy_entity: Energy counter of the wallbox (Wh or kWh). It tells charging at home from charging away.
data_description.departure_entity: A time or date-time entity (for example a helper). If set, it replaces the departure Plugwhen has learned.
data_description.notify_service: One or more notify services, separated by commas, for example notify.mobile_app_phone, notify.mobile_app_tablet. Used for the warning that the car will not be ready. Leave empty for none.
data_description.notify_hour: The warning is sent from this hour of the evening on, once per departure.
